Name: Visible column has no description
Description: Visible columns should carry a description so that report authors know what they hold.

Name: Measure has no format string
Description: Every measure should state how it is displayed.

Name: Measure has no description
Description: Every measure needs a description that states its unit and sign convention.

Name: Avoid IFERROR in measures
Description: IFERROR forces cell-by-cell evaluation; use DIVIDE or explicit tests instead.
